core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing to type I interferon
name: RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and interferon-alpha antiviral effector response
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5 and cytosolic DNA sensing through IRF3 to type I IFN, and unlike the confusables (IFN-beta production, TBK1 regulation, TLR7/8/9) the theme adds downstream IFN-alpha response, OAS and IP-10 antiviral effectors.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance in wound re-epithelialization
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte or epithelial proliferation, differentiation, death and adhesion, with wound epidermal spreading distinguishing it from confusables about cornification, skin appendages and melanocytes.

name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon outgrowth, sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A/CRMP/RHOA growth inhibition, distinct from confusables on myelination and glia or on guidance-linked axon extension.

name: Calcitonin/amylin and glucagon-type peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are peptide hormone receptors coupled to adenylate cyclase/cAMP with nutrient and GH secretion outputs; calcitonin-like, amylin, CGRP and relaxin receptors separate it from free fatty acid, incretin and feeding confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP growth control with replicative senescence and lifespan
rationale: Members concern Hippo/YAP-TAZ density-dependent growth control, and the senescence, lifespan, growth rate and X-ray response members distinguish it from confusables that share the Hippo core but add AP-2, PDGF, anoikis or TGF-beta mutant content.

name: Intra-Golgi retrograde vesicle recycling
rationale: All three members describe vesicle traffic and recycling between Golgi cisternae, unlike confusables on Golgi-endosome/TGN transport, lysosomal sorting or Golgi structural organization.

name: RUNX1-driven transcription and megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1 target and regulation programs plus megakaryocyte, platelet and erythroid differentiation modules, distinct from confusables on granulopoiesis, myeloid progenitors and HSC maintenance.

qualifier: docking, priming and transmitter-specific release cycles
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members concern vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent fusion releasing neurotransmitters, distinct from confusables on vesicle recycling, active zone structure and synaptic plasticity.

name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB activation via IKK complex
rationale: Members cover IKK/TAK1-dependent canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kappaB from TNFR1, TLR, TCR/BCR and their ubiquitin regulation and deficiencies, distinct from confusables centred on NOD/TAK1-driven JNK/p38 or TLR negative regulation.

qualifier: dendritic, T and NK cells via CCR7/CXCR4
name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members concern chemokines and receptors directing migration of dendritic, T and NK cells, distinct from confusables on mast/astrocyte chemotaxis, B cell homing and integrin adhesion.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFRA with inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic FLT3, ALK, FGFR, PDGFRA mutants and inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer-associated mutant or fusion RTK signaling and TKI binding/resistance for FLT3, ALK/LTK, FGFR1-3 and PDGFRA/B, distinct from KIT-focused and normal FLT3/cytokine-STAT5 confusables.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and pacemaker coupling
rationale: Members concern SA/AV node and His-Purkinje development, HCN pacemaking and gap-junction coupling, unlike confusables about action-potential phases and myocyte depolarization/repolarization.

qualifier: plasma membrane dopamine and norepinephrine transporters
name: Dopamine and norepinephrine transporter-mediated catecholamine reuptake
rationale: All members concern monoamine/catecholamine transport and SLC6A2/SLC6A3 reuptake defects, distinct from confusables on vesicular loading, catecholamine degradation and dopamine synthesis/signaling.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and matriglycan synthesis in dystroglycanopathy
rationale: All members concern O-mannosyl glycan synthesis on DAG1 and its congenital muscular dystrophy defects, distinct from confusables on dystrophin complex, GAG/keratan sulfate and GDP-mannose synthesis.

name: Endocytic receptor recycling and constitutive secretory traffic
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling to the plasma membrane plus constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane targeting, distinct from Golgi-retrograde, endosome maturation and Rab/ARF GTPase confusables.

core: Protein ADP-ribosylation in DNA damage response
name: Protein ADP-ribosylation in DNA break chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members concern ADP-ribosylation and its removal coupled to break-site recruitment, repair chromatin remodeling, R-loops and NHEJ restraint, distinct from confusables on NHEJ/HR execution, replication-fork and nucleosome assembly.

name: RAS-RAF-MAPK cascade, oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK activation, its disease mutants and negative feedback/dephosphorylation, distinct from confusables on ERK5, AP-1/IL-6, IRS and Rap1-integrin signaling.

name: Adenylate cyclase activation and cAMP-PKA-CREB signaling
rationale: Members concern cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 signaling downstream of stimulatory GPCRs, distinct from confusables on Gi/alpha-2 adrenergic cyclase inhibition and PLC/IP3 signaling.

name: Centrosome positioning, centriole cohesion and microtubule nucleation
rationale: Members concern centrosome localization, centriole cohesion and microtubule nucleation/anchoring at the MTOC, distinct from mitotic centrosome maturation, cilia and spindle orientation confusables.

name: SLC amino acid transport and inherited renal aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated amino acid (and urate) transport and their cystinuria, Hartnup and iminoglycinuria defects, distinct from confusables on oligopeptide, organic anion/cation and urate metabolism.

qualifier: proinflammatory IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production
name: TLR-driven proinflammatory cytokine production and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR/CD40 signaling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, distinct from confusables on IL-1 family signaling and core TRIF/TAK1 signaling steps.

name: Ephrin-EPH repulsion and DCC attraction in axon guidance
rationale: Members concern ephrin/EPH growth cone collapse and repulsion plus DCC attraction via RAC1, distinct from ROBO-SLIT, netrin repulsion and filopodium confusables.

name: CSF-driven neutrophil granulopoiesis and its transcriptional control
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/granulocyte differentiation, its transcriptional control and G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling, distinct from confusables on broader myeloid progenitor, eosinophil, mast and macrophage differentiation.

name: Pharyngeal endoderm-derived organ development
rationale: Thyroid, thymus and parathyroid all arise from pharyngeal endoderm, distinguishing the theme from inner ear, outflow tract, craniofacial and mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: cancer mutants and TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation
name: Cancer TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants, TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 plus TGFBR3 regulation, distinct from confusables on RUNX3/Hippo, activin/AMH and normal SMAD transcriptional signaling.
